description: This script generates a JSON database for dictionary-based logging from a Zephyr ELF binary, extracting strings, symbols, and logging subsystem info.

classes.name: LogDatabase
classes.description: Class representing the logging database, used to store extracted ELF info.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for the script.

methods.name: extract_elf_code_data_sections
methods.description: Finds code/data sections in ELF file.

methods.name: find_elf_sections
methods.description: Finds specific sections in ELF file by name.

methods.name: get_kconfig_symbols
methods.description: Retrieves kconfig symbols from ELF symbol table.

methods.name: parse_log_const_symbols
methods.description: Parses log constant symbols to map source IDs to names.

methods.name: extract_elf_information
methods.description: Extracts ELF header info like endianness and architecture.

methods.name: process_kconfigs
methods.description: Processes kconfig symbols to determine target bits and architecture.

methods.name: extract_logging_subsys_information
methods.description: Extracts logging subsystem info, such as log instances.

methods.name: is_die_attr_ref
methods.description: Checks if a DWARF attribute is a reference.

methods.name: find_die_var_base_type
methods.description: Finds the base type name of a DWARF variable.

methods.name: is_die_var_const_char
methods.description: Checks if a DWARF variable is a const char.

methods.name: extract_string_variables
methods.description: Finds all string variables in ELF DWARF info.

methods.name: try_decode_string
methods.description: Attempts to decode a byte string as printable string.

methods.name: is_printable
methods.description: Checks if a byte is printable or acceptable escape.

methods.name: extract_strings_in_one_section
methods.description: Extracts NULL-terminated strings from a section.

methods.name: extract_static_strings
methods.description: Extracts static strings from ELF using DWARF and sections.
